item.title: Can a robotics startup survive by pivoting from hardware to data scraping?
item.summary: According to public posts from one of their engineers, they're now: · Scraping 1M+ hours of POV video from the internet · Burning significant GPU hours while models only work for basic tasks · Down to This raises a broader question: · Is scraping public video a viable long-term data strategy, or a dead end? · Are there examples of hardware companies that successfully made this pivot? They originally built Eggie, a multipurpose humanoid robot, but Tangible has since pivoted to building an AI foundation model for robotics.
